title: Personalised Wheelie Bin Sticker – Design 30
descriptionHtml:
Bin day is so much easier when you can spot your own bin from the end of the street. This personalised wheelie bin sticker does exactly that. In our sample artwork for design 30 it reads "74 Overthere Avenue", but yours will show your own address.

Personalised Wheelie Bin Sticker – Design 30

Just add your house number, your street name and the colours you like. We cut and print your pair to order.

Why you'll love it

  • Helps bin crews and neighbours return your bin to the right house
  • Clear, bold layout in our design 30 style
  • A pair of stickers in every order
  • Pick the colours that suit your home
  • Cut and printed in our own workshop

Size & details

  • Pack: pair (2 stickers)
  • Personalised with your house number, street name and colours
  • Sticker size, vinyl type and outdoor life: please call us before ordering if you need exact details

Delivery

Your stickers are made to order in our North Yorkshire workshop and posted from the UK. Delivery options and costs are shown at checkout. Any questions, call us on 01439 771468.

Buying for a new neighbour? A pair of personalised bin stickers is a thoughtful housewarming touch.
